$comment: Texas appraisal district bulk-data directory. Catalogued 15 Aug 2026.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Texas has no state-published parcel file. 254 districts
publish separately, in four different layouts, and nobody has published a
directory of where. Building one is a moat; guessing at one is a liability.
HOW TO READ `confidence`:
verified   the data page was fetched and the links below were read off it
indexed    the page is known to exist but could not be rendered server-side
(JavaScript portal or bot-blocking). Needs a real browser.
not_found  no public data page located. Treat as public-information-request.
A GUESSED URL IS WORSE THAN A MISSING ONE, because a scraper gets built
against it. Nothing in `files` was constructed by pattern; every entry was
read from a page. HEAD-check before wiring a downloader anyway — see
scripts/tx/fetch.sh, which does exactly that and refuses on a redirect to
an HTML error page.
cad_id is the Comptroller's 3-digit county code (001 Anderson .. 254 Zavala),
which is also the prefix of an EARS filename. Backfilled 16 Aug from
comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/resources/county-codes.php and cross-checked against
Travis CAD's own EARS filename (227EARS...). It is NOT derived by alphabetising
county names: the Comptroller sorts 'El Paso' as if the space were absent, so
Ellis is 070 and El Paso is 071, and a naive sort reverses them.
cad_id sits in the tx_parcels PRIMARY KEY. A wrong code does not error — it
silently files a whole district's parcels under another county.
Canonical copy: lib/tx/counties.js.
FILENAME STABILITY. Only El Paso and Grayson use paths that do not change
between rolls, so only those two can be polled on a schedule by URL. Everywhere
else the filename embeds a date or supplement number and the listing page must
be re-parsed each run.

formats.PACS: Harris Govern / True Automation. Fixed-width, ~19 files, versioned layout 8.0.x (current 8.0.33/8.0.34). Roughly two-thirds of Texas. ONE PARSER COVERS ALL OF THESE.
formats.HCAD: Harris County's own schema. Tab-delimited ASCII, zipped. Fully documented codebook.
formats.ORION: Tyler Technologies Orion. Filenames literally contain 'Orion'. Fort Bend and Hays.
formats.ISW: Interactive Software / Southwest Data Solutions. Parker, Midland, Tom Green, Henderson.
formats.EARS: The Comptroller submission format itself. Only Travis publishes it. Documented in Form 96-1051.
formats.TAB_DELIM: Tab-delimited .tab files with header rows on most members (externalnal.tab, externalbld.tab, externalland.tab). Bell. NOT PACS despite Bell publishing a PACS layout document — verified by opening the archive 16 Aug. Needs its own parser; the header rows make it self-describing, so it is easier than PACS, just different.

districts.notes: Best-documented large district, and the ONLY one publishing raw EARS. Its public posting of EARS is the precedent cited in our request to the Comptroller. Also publishes JSON, which is the cheapest possible parser validation target.

Best-organised of the 45. Stable paths mean this one CAN be polled on a schedule. Separate 2027 staging files already exist on the blob store. Layout is 8.0.34, one version ahead of most — validate the parser against both.
LOADED 16 Aug: 209,481 read -> 115,001 residential. Export header says 8.0.0.34 while the layout Nueces publishes is 8.0.33. Living area = MA "MAIN AREA".

NOT PACS. Bell publishes an 'Appraisal Export Layout 8.0.33.xlsx' on its data page, but the actual export is 12 tab-delimited .tab files — externalnal, externalbld, externalland, externalsale, externalexemptions and others — most carrying a header row. Confirmed by opening the archive. The published layout document describes a format this district does not ship. Second district found doing this; treat every published layout as a hint, not a contract.

Best-structured offering in the state: full export, JSON, a simplified one-row-per-account file, and GIS parcels with appraisal attributes already joined. Terms state the data is 'considered in the public domain and is distributed without warranty of any kind'. Full export unzips to ~6.8 GB.

FIRST PILOT. The CSV property data export is self-describing — the header row names the fields — so it validates the schema without any layout guesswork. Also publishes ARB protest DECISIONS, which is the outcomes data we want for the expected-reduction model outside Harris.

RESOLVED 8 Sept 2026. Free, unauthenticated, direct URLs; 2027 404s so 2026 is current. ASCII TAB-DELIMITED with header rows per HCAD Import_Instructions — third-party repos calling it fixed-width describe older vintages. Bespoke schema, 13-digit acct, needs its own parser. Fields: heat_ar, date_erected, land_val, tot_mkt_val, tot_appr_val, Neighborhood_Code, state_class, qa_cd. NO condition code and NO explicit cap-loss field — a Cap_acct flag exists and cap loss is PROBABLY market minus appraised, but HCAD publishes no definition, so verify empirically before relying on it. UNIQUELY ships arb_protest_real.txt and arb_hearings_real.txt: real per-account protest and hearing OUTCOMES, which nobody else publishes. Refresh cadence in-season is UNKNOWN and is the open question that decides whether Harris works during Apr-May.
Deepest history of any district — certified and preliminary rolls back to 2017, at supplement granularity. Useful for the year-over-year cap verification described in schema.sql.

LOADED 16 Aug from the 2026 file: 154,028 read -> 80,553 residential. THE 2025 FILE IS LAYOUT 8.0.0.30 AND IS CORRECTLY REFUSED by the version guard — do not "fix" that by widening the accepted set without diffing the offsets first. Living area = HSE "HOUSE" plus SEC "SECOND STORY".
LOADED 16 Aug: 108,592 read -> 65,012 residential. Living area = LA "LIVING AREA". 11 ragged records, well under threshold.

LOADED 16 Aug: 60,174 read -> 42,249 residential. Data is 8.0.0.34 despite the published layout being 8.0.25. Living area = LV "LIVING AREA", not MA — this district is why the living-area matcher works on descriptions rather than codes.
LOADED 16 Aug: 86,008 read -> 45,638 residential. Living area = MA "MAIN AREA".
Stable path — pollable on a schedule. Layout ships inside the zip.
Certified filename is an opaque batch number — the listing page must be parsed, the URL cannot be constructed.
Own comma-delimited format, not PACS. Low priority — small market, bespoke parser.
The certified and preliminary rolls sit behind pCloud share links rather than plain HTTP, so they cannot be curl'd directly. Historic data back to 1998.

districts.login: full export requires open-records; Lite export is a public folder
districts.notes: Lite export is a zipped MS Access .mdb — needs mdbtools to read on macOS/Linux. Collin also self-publishes a 502k-row property slice to data.texas.gov (5tkr-3759) with nbhdCode and marketAreaCode but NOT values, and its protest data as xmrt-bxjr. Data described as public domain.

Four published layout PDFs — the best documentation after HCAD. Data files route through a Socrata browse portal (data.wcad.org) rather than direct links, so the file URLs are not captured. Disclaimer is as-is with no commercial restriction.

STALE — the newest file on the page is the 2024 certified export. No 2025 or 2026. This is a live gap for a Houston-metro county of 850k people and warrants a phone call, not a scraper. No published layout either.

RESOLVED 8 Sept 2026. The 15 Aug entry said "unknown format / likely paid" and BOTH were wrong: it is free, no registration, no published licence or redistribution restriction. NOT PACS — in-house CAMA called MARS on SQL Server. Use the comma-delimited relational set, not the fixed roll: the fixed roll has no year built, no neighborhood code and no class code. CSV set carries NBHD_CD, SPTD_CD, BLDG_CLASS_DESC, TOT_LIVING_AREA_SF, YR_BUILT and CAPPED_HS_AMT (a real explicit cap-loss field, better than Harris). Residential condition absent; DESIRABILITY_RATING is the only proxy. Dictionary ships inside the zip. Also publishes MAIL1/2/3 notice-value files, which is what makes the April window workable.

RESOLVED 8 Sept 2026, and the 15 Aug entry was out of date. TAD moved off Aumentum to TRUE PRODIGY for the 2026 roll and now emits a PACS-family fixed-width export with a published layout (Legacy 8.0.33) — the El Paso parser should largely carry over. ~713 MB. The old data-downloads.php URL is Cloudflare-blocked; the extensionless path works. Legacy PropertyData files are refreshed continuously (so they exist during the Apr-May window) but carry NO neighborhood code and NO class code — unusable for comps. ARB mail goes to its own PO Box 185519, Fort Worth 76181, NOT the district. LAYOUT VERIFIED 9 Sept 2026 against scripts/tx/pacs_8_0_34.json, field by field: 467 byte ranges are identical between 8.0.33 and 8.0.34, and ALL 12 FIELDS load.mjs ACTUALLY READS sit at identical offsets (prop_id 1-12, situs_street 1050-1099, abs_subdv_cd 1676-1685, market_value 4214-4227, nhs_cap_loss 9068-9082, imprv_det_area 94-108 and yr_built 86-89 in the detail file, appraised_value 404-418 in the entity file). The two versions differ ONLY in naming: 8.0.33 carves named fields out of regions 8.0.34 leaves as `filler` (ownership_pct, mineral_lease_id) and the exemption block was renamed (df_* -> fdhs_*, bpp_ex_* -> 145b_*). No net shift anywhere. THE EXISTING LOADER PARSES TARRANT UNCHANGED. Note the first diff is a name-vs-name comparison trap: comparing field NAMES reports "0 shifted" for the wrong reason, because 22 ranges are renames. Compare BYTE RANGES.
One district serving two counties — Potter and Randall. The cad_id/appraising_cad split in schema.sql exists for exactly this.

CONFIRMED 8 Sept 2026: still no free bulk download. PIA request only (CD/DVD/FTP), electronic-data pricing NOT published. Runs Harris Govern/True Automation PACS per its own Reappraisal Plan, so the export is very likely 8.x fixed-width, but BCAD publishes no layout so that is inference. Separately: BCAD hosts an UNSWORN DECLARATION form citing CPRC 132.001 by name, and its ARB procedures cite TAX CODE 41.45(n) as allowing evidence by "notarized affidavit or unsworn declaration" — a subsection we had not found. See claude/TX_Counsel_Brief_2026-09-07.md.
No bulk roll, but DOES publish a protest hearing database xlsx per year.
Downloads page is GIS only. Property search requires a login.
Downloads page carries forms and PDFs only.
No own domain — hosted on iswdataclient.azurewebsites.net.

hearing_outcome_publishers.$comment: Free, account-level, historical OUTCOMES data — initial vs final value per account. This is how the expected-reduction model gets built, and how the invented avgSavings numbers on 69 city pages get replaced with sourced ones. Harris additionally tags each row with Agent_Code, which identifies the firm, so competitor performance is measurable from public data.
